data.name: Hellsplit: Labyrinth
data.detailed_description:
Hellsplit: Labyrinth is a rogue-like VR action RPG set in a dark fantasy world. As an elite warrior, you must complete a mission of utmost importance: recover the seven shards of a powerful magical crystal - no matter the cost. Venture into a realm filled with ruthless enemies, deadly traps, and priceless treasures. The path you choose is yours alone, but remember: you only have one life. There are no second chances.

FEATURES

  • A unique gameplay experience in which you and your character are one and the same - a full-fledged avatar that precisely mimics your movements.

  • Physically realistic battles using the weapons and equipment of medieval warriors. The characteristics are as close as possible to their real prototypes.

  • Realistic body movements and a life-like injury system - superficial wounds, dismemberment.

  • A deep RPG progression system that lets you shape your hero to match your unique playstyle.

  • 8 distinct biomes, crafted in the signature dark fantasy style of the Hellsplit universe.

  • Procedurally generated levels, ensuring that every run features new routes, encounters, and challenges.

  • An engaging story with multiple endings determined by the choices you make.

  • New weapons, armor, enemies, and powerful bosses to discover and conquer.

  • A full-fledged, room-scale VR experience - the game requires the player to be standing, with the ability to move through real space over an area of 1.5 x 1.5 meters, and supports VR controllers.

  • High-quality graphics and sound.

data.short_description: A rogue-like VR action RPG with brutal, physics-driven medieval combat. Collect seven crystal shards across procedural dungeons. You get one life. No second chances.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Mínimos:
  • Requer um sistema operativo e processador de 64 bits
  • Sistema Operativo *: Windows 7, 8.1, 10, 11 (64-bit versions)
  • Processador: Intel Core i5-6600K or AMD Ryzen 5 1400 or better
  • Memória: 8 GB de RAM
  • Placa gráfica: Nvidia GeForce GTX 970 / AMD RX 480 8GB or better
  • Espaço no disco: Requer 10 GB de espaço livre
  • Compatibilidade com R.V.: OpenXR
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recomendados:
  • Requer um sistema operativo e processador de 64 bits
  • Sistema Operativo: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processador: Intel Core i7-4790 or AMD Ryzen 5 1500X
  • Memória: 8 GB de RAM
  • Placa gráfica: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1070 8GB / AMD RX Vega 56 8GB
  • Espaço no disco: Requer 10 GB de espaço livre
  • Compatibilidade com R.V.: OpenXR

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains frequent realistic violence, gore, and dismemberment, including stabbing, cutting, and crushing of enemies in a VR medieval fantasy setting. Combat is highly visceral and may include blood effects and detailed physical injury to humanoid enemies.
